STUDIO NORTHSTAR TRAVEL — SERVICE AGREEMENT

Client: Maya Reeves
Travellers: Maya Reeves, Jamie Lopez (party of 2)
Destination: Japan — Tokyo (6 nights) and Kyoto (3 nights)
Trip dates: 11–22 April 2026
Booking reference: NRT8841

ITEMIZED PACKAGE
- Return flights LHR–HND–LHR (economy, 2 travellers): EUR 985.00
- Agency service fee: EUR 120.00
- Tokyo Riverside Hotel, 6 nights (11–17 April): JPY 168,000
- Kyoto Ryokan Sakura, 3 nights (17–20 April): JPY 96,000
- 7-day Japan Rail Pass (2 travellers): JPY 50,000
- Two guided day tours (Tokyo + Kyoto): JPY 38,000

Total package value approximately EUR 3,150, payable in two instalments (deposit + balance). Instalment 1 covers the flights and service fee; instalment 2 covers the JPY accommodation, rail pass and tours.

Discretionary spending (meals, activities, shopping) is not included and is settled directly by the client.

Enjoy Japan!
Studio Northstar Travel
